notes.title: Seeker: Quest - Release Date: 30th of September
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone!



Here is the latest devlog for the Seeker: Quest - You can watch it on my Youtube
[previewyoutube="Mll_mKmtVTQ;full"][/previewyoutube]
Seeker: Quest will be released on 30th of September 2025! Be sure to mark your calendars. <3



Here is the text version of the update:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088802/5d65d2e978036da5c65d5d579359de6494448bd4.png"]

As I’m starting to make one game each month for the next 24 months, I need to have some sort of a plan for each game. So, let’s talk about the first game release that will happen on 30th of September, 2025.
[p align="start"]Like mentioned in my Devlog #2: It’s Seeker: Quest!
[p align="start"]It has been in development for some time and I’ve been struggling to finalize it. It all became unsustainable since it involved a lot of learning in basically all areas of my development skills, especially programming.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088802/a5d32c1a63e9d923fa87b1c49489b60a39712272.png"]


[p align="start"]HOW IT ALL STARTED
[p align="start"]Seeker: Quest started as a small project with my three kids. I kept adding features based on their requests, without any grand plan or design document to guide it.
[p align="start"]This ultimately turned into something chaotic. But still, I find the game unique in many ways and I’m proud of it. The challenge is that it takes new players a while to grasp, and not everyone has the patience for that, which is understandable.


[p align="start"]WHAT’S THE ’FUN’ IN SEEKER: QUEST?
[p align="start"]It’s definitely exploring all the playable characters and finding a good combination of Seekers to survive the ever-challenging levels. It is also a fun challenge to unlock all the Seekers and achievements.


[p align="start"]WHAT’S NEXT?
[p align="start"]I tried improving the new player onboarding in recent updates, but quickly realized it would be almost as much work as rebuilding the game from scratch. Just because it’s been coded rather badly.
[p align="start"]Luckily, a good number of people have already enjoyed the game, and because of this, I decided it’s better to move on with the project and just crunch it to the finish line.
[p align="start"]In September, I’ll focus on finishing up Seeker: Quest with:

The Spirit Island (new area to explore, including new Seekers and a boss fight)

The Leerking Battle (final boss that completes the story)

Missing story dialogues

Small onboarding improvements to make it easier to explore the mechanics
[p align="start"]
Seeker: Quest will be released on 30th of September, 2025!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088802/ffba81a063598bd3d63d42c331d246eb902f34e0.png"]


[p align="start"]HOW CAN I GET SEEKER: QUEST?
[p align="start"]You can either become a (paid 3 EUR/month) member on Patreon to get the game, purchase it on Steam, or itch.io. (Already available as Steam Early Access)
[p align="start"]Also, in case you want to hear more about my grand plan of shipping 24 games in 24 months, you can watch the Devlog #1 on Youtube!
[p align="start"]Thanks for following along, and I can’t wait for you to try Seeker: Quest when it launches!

notes.title: HOTFIX: Removed Viburleon from playable characters
notes.notes:
Whoopsie!

Last night I had a quick update to address the issue where some of the users had hard time to start the game (it closed automatically after startup). This was fixed (as I'm aware of), but IF you still encounter this, please let me know. The workaround right now is to click the black screen when it opens couple of times (before it closes automatically).

But in this update, I removed my "quick fix error" since I forgot to remove the Viburleon Seeker from the playable characters.

Viburleon is the upcoming Boss fight for the Stardust Island. The character shouldn't be playable (yet). So, it should now be removed from your list if you had it, but also you're not able to get it anymore.

Sorry! :)

notes.title: HOTFIX: Game closing on startup
notes.notes:
There was an issue for some of the users, that the game closed right after startup. There was a workaround to click on the opening screen, before it closes. This would start the game normally.

Now the game is updated and the issue should be resolved.

Please post feedback on the forums, if the problem persists!

notes.title: Stardust Island Is Here! – Seeker: Quest BIG Update

notes.title: HOTFIX: The "Score Screen Black Screen"
notes.notes:
We encountered some random "game freezes" when exiting the score screen and going back to village. 

This seems to be happening randomly currently, which makes it hard to fix 100%. This patch is the attempt to fix it for good.

Please note that the "freeze" does not take away any of your game progress. You'll still get all the items and experience from the level you played before the freeze. If this still happens, you just need to re-open the game to continue playing.

notes.title: GIANTS & POOPLETS: Season Update - Seeker: Quest
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone!

The Christmas season is here and we are prepared. The "Poppy" Seeker has established his very own island into Seeker: Quest and you're able to obtain him as a playable character. 

Poppy will be removed from the game on January, but if you're able to catch & hatch him before that, his forever yours! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088802/499f9cb242f85235ec487dcb9da4dd66f00f7ba8.png

But as always, that won't be an easy task. The "Poppy's Paradise" level is guarded by not only waves of Seekers, but the new Seeker "Giants". The level is best suited for a good Seeker roster, so prepare your team before jumping into the Poppy's Paradise level.

The Giants are here to stay. Functionality is rather simple: Any of the spawning enemy Seekers can become a "Giant" which means it has more power, more speed, more health and... You guessed it. More loot!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088802/2c05cda597e7e4b310274d03865f7461c1c31d65.png

There is also two new unique abilities added into the Treasure Chest loot. "Pooplet Drop" and the "Lootbag". 

Plus not to mention the various amount of bug fixes and polishing!

Now would be a good time to jump in and start preparing your roster for the Poppy's Paradise for some crazy time! 

Remember to join our Discord channel for further discussions and to offer your valuable feedback. 

I also post weekly content to my Youtube channel, if you're interested in following the journey of an independent solo game developer. It's harsh, I know. But at least I'm sharing my progress as transparent as possible!

See you in flower fields of Seeker: Quest! (Steam Page)

All the best,
Klaus
The Jester

notes.title: Seeker: Quest v0.48 - NEW SEASONAL SEEKER (Patch notes)
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone!

Thank you very much for yesterdays launch party, it was so great to stream with such an active people in the chat. <3

But today I decided to address most of the issues that people have encountered during the first day of gameplay. (See patch notes below)

But that's not all. There is a new SEASONAL SEEKER available in the game: Poppy!

Poppy will spawn in secret locations, but only with a 35% chance! 

Poppy will be available within the game until the end of year. So be sure to go and catch it before that!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088802/fc869614c47b7fc04d0c776ed1ed7b801c0b21f6.png


 Added a new Seasonal Seeker into the game. “Poppy”. Poppy will spawn on some specific levels by random. If you can find him, defeat him and obtain its Seekegg, you’ll unlock it as a playable character.
 The Bullets got renamed to: Pooplets
 There is now proper information for using the number keys for character selection
 Added “Out of ammo” -sound
 Added reload sound when obtaining new bullets
 Added more clear information for the character selection to press E to begin the level
 Quard has the wrong Seekegg visuals. Should now be the Fire Seekegg
 “Knocked out” text was not disappearing on the inventory screen when closing the character selection window. Should not behave as expected.
 Village building texts were someway cut off from the screen. Should now be fixed.


Happy adventures everyone and remember to join our growing Discord channel! We just arranged an competition to design a new Seeker. The winner Seeker design will be implemented into the game rather soon!

Have a great week everyone!

notes.title: Patch v0.47 (Patch notes) - Risky update before launch
notes.notes:
Greetings!

I like living on the edge. This time I'm doing it by releasing an update couple of hours before the release. I just had to do it. I got the "Mini Bosses" feature functioning (as it seems) and also some bug fixes, which I wanted to address.

Seeker: Quest Steam Store Page

Patchnotes below:

Please note that the controller is kind of supported now. But for best gaming experience, I suggest using keyboard only. You may encounter some funny stuff within the user interface, if even having a controller plugged in. 

- Added round range indicator to characters (Easier to see how far you can strike)
- Added randomly spawning "Mini Bosses" - There is a 5% chance that any enemy that spawns is a "Mini Boss" - which has high attributes and deals massive damage. It also glows.
- Enemy Kabook Detonation was dealing flat damage, it should now scale depending on it's level and elements
- Mughi had lost it's vision and was no longer chasing the player, instead, running around aimlessly. Should now have its vision back.
- Dart was dealing flat damage on rocket hit. Should now be fixed to deal damage accordining his own damage. (Before was flat 50)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088802/991c67b414adff5da2276c703d28b7ca7d645ee9.png

Come join our Discord channel for further discussions!

PS:
If you want to check out my Youtube video I just uploaded, where I reflect the thoughts of the upcoming release, you can see it HERE.

notes.title: Small update - Seeker: Quest v0.46
notes.notes:
Hey!

Just a quick update to address some issues, but also add a small layer of polish. Some of the items below:

- Added effects for Arena Island bosses when they spawn
- Changed Leer Norzu boss bullet behavior (it slows now and destroys when hitting walls)
- Changed sizes for both Arena Island bosses (Quard & Isegon)
- Disabled player being able to move when dead (could do it for couple of seconds)
- Added more power to hero ability Wild Bag (from 1 to 5)
- Changed dialogue "Let's scout that forest..." to "Let's scout that island" - referring to Haven Island
- Added more controller support visuals. (Information for player which button works and such, still some scenes are missing the information, ex. hatching scene + score)
- Added soud effects for Cruone, Isegon, Mughi, Quard (Death + take hit sounds)
- Changed Mughi behavior so that it chases the player more often (cooldown decreased by 3 seconds)

Looking forward to tomorrows release!

Br,
Klaus

notes.title: Seeker: Quest – Early Access Release Date
notes.notes:
Seeker: Quest Early Access Release Date: December 12, 2024
Seeker: Quest is finally going live on Steam Early Access on December 12th, 2024! 🎉

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088802/387ec40044a51f22b5440a44b04729b9ac6b9207.png

After a lot of hard work, it’s time for you to get your hands on this monster-collecting RPG adventure. I’m incredibly excited to bring you all into the world of Naturia where Seekers roam and battles are fierce. This early access version will allow us to shape the game together, and your feedback will be invaluable.

But, let’s be clear: the game isn’t finished yet. There’s much more to come, and I want you to be part of this journey with me! Expect new Seekers, islands, levels, and plenty of features to be added in future updates.

Stay tuned for more announcements, and don’t forget to join our Discord for updates and community discussions!

And there’s more coming soon... 🔥

notes.title: New Patch (08/12/23) - More speed! | LAST PATCH BEFORE CLOSING THE DEMO
notes.notes:
Greetings adventurers!

I've just rolled out a new patch which adds some "quality of life" -things for the demo, but also some balancing for character speeds, damages and more. There is also a new version for the targeting system in place now! I've decided to change it a little, to be more clear who you are currently targeting at.

I also noticed one bug just before going live with the patch, but decided to fix it a little later: Some of the keybinds show controller binds in the UI, even though there is no controller plugged. In most of the cases, the keyboard control is "Q" rather than "B", what the UI suggests.

PLEASE NOTE: This is the LAST PATCH I'll do before closing down the demo. I'll keep the demo available for download for a couple of weeks now and then close it for good. Hope to see you trying the game!

Be sure to join our Discord and follow me on Instagram!

Best regards,
Klaus, The Jester
Jestercraft.com

notes.title: Seeker: Quest Demo MAJOR PATCH #2
notes.notes:
Hello, Adventurers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088802/00caea970870bc22ab1ea0f3d3225e943d930b31.png

It's time for another MAJOR UPDATE! The patch contains numerous changes, fixes, additions, and even new features. Check out the patch notes below:


 Hero selection: You can now choose a hero from three exiled Jesterians: Draven, Azrael, and Nama'Ghal.
 Each hero features three different 'Hero Cards' that can be used during levels.
 Several new Seekers to battle against and capture, each with their unique abilities.
 Bullet system: Each Seeker has a set amount of bullets that regenerate over time (depending on the cooldown stat of that Seeker).
 A story trailer has been added at the beginning of the game (Can be skipped with ESC).
 Modified all Seeker stats.


KNOWN BUGS (Fixes coming soon)

 If two or more Seekers gain a level up at the same time, the game may "freeze." If this occurs, the game needs to be restarted.
 The Boulder trap behaves strangely at times (gets stuck in places where it shouldn't).
 Currently, the player can move in the Village before the dialogues start, which may cause a "strange feeling" for some players (as they get interrupted by the dialogue suddenly).


Be sure to play the Seeker: Quest Demo and check out the new story trailer on Youtube 

And why not join our Discord for further discussions of the game!

Happy adventuring!

Best wishes,
Klaus, The Jester
Jestercraft

notes.title: Seeker: Quest Big Demo Update NOW LIVE!
notes.notes:
Greetings adventurers!

The day has finally come! After long nights and a lot of bug squashing I've managed to get a big update for Seeker: Quest demo on Steam. 

[previewyoutube=qj_2CWHv1j4;full][/previewyoutube]

This Seeker game demo will work as the building base for me to polish the demo content to as good condition as I possibly can before the Steam Next Fest which is happening at the start of next month. (October 9th 2023)

The demo features at least the following features/elements:
- 3 levels
- 1 boss fight
- Multiple stat items to boost your Seekers
- Two buildings to unlock
- 6 unlockable seekers

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088802/321ba5443658ffff94282c7fa4d00b6717c543aa.png
Showcase of Batterim Character

Since Seeker Quest is the first game I've ever programmed 100% solo, it's been a very demanding, but educating project so far. Naturally, there is still a lot to do with the game but with this demo update I actually managed to cut down features, ease the work load and focus on delivering better quality for the existing features.

In case you're sitting on your PC at this moment, you can play the updated Seeker Quest Demo on Steam right now.

The Steam Next Fest 2023 will be a big event for the Seeker Quest but also for the whole Seeker Universe. I'm trying my best to share the word of my on-going and let people know, that the Seeker world is much more than "just a game". For me, the story is the biggest thing which I want to share in different medias. In case you're interested in knowing more about the Seeker Universe story, you're welcome to join our Patreon or Instagram!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088802/84555469511843124467b70bb16f3a6adf69d3dc.png
Showcase of Boomin Character
